external_research.title: Bucketing the Good Apples: A Method for Diagnosing and Improving Causal Abstraction
external_research.authors: Li Puyin, Jiyuan Tan, Ahmad Jabbar, Thomas Icard, Atticus Geiger
external_research.finding_scope: A single global interchange-intervention accuracy can conceal well-interpreted and under-interpreted regions. Pair/input partitioning reveals where a causal abstraction succeeds, fails, and which missing distinctions may matter.
external_research.project_effect: Trigger-2 must not promote Global J-Space/Hyperposition causality from an aggregate intervention score alone. Exact family/context/function buckets and coverage are required. METHOD_INPUT_ONLY.

external_research.title: The Non-Linear Representation Dilemma: Is Causal Abstraction Enough for Mechanistic Interpretability?
external_research.authors: Denis Sutter, Julian Minder, Thomas Hofmann, Tiago Pimentel
external_research.finding_scope: With sufficiently expressive alignment maps, high causal-abstraction scores can become uninformative; the reported analysis can align even randomly initialized models to algorithms under overly flexible mappings.
external_research.project_effect: Positive J-Space causal evidence requires a preregistered restricted alignment/projection class and complexity budget plus negative controls. Post-hoc capacity expansion is promotion-invalidating. METHOD_INPUT_ONLY.

external_research.title: How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?
external_research.authors: Yiwei Wu, Atticus Geiger, Raphael Milliere
external_research.finding_scope: Systematic variable-binding mechanisms can emerge after shallow heuristic phases while earlier heuristics remain part of the final solution; causal interventions identify the systematic routing mechanism.
external_research.project_effect: Complements the current developmental READ/BIND_ROUTE/WRITE lane: a high endpoint binding score does not prove shortcut replacement, so bucketed causal evaluation must include shortcut-solvable and shortcut-contradicting regions. METHOD_INPUT_ONLY.

hypothesis: Global J-Space causal promotion is most vulnerable after aggregate success: a small model may achieve a strong mean intervention score by being causally faithful only on shortcut-friendly contexts, or an overly expressive alignment map may fit the declared causal abstraction without revealing a reusable mechanism.
counterhypothesis: If aggregate intervention accuracy is sufficiently high and held-out task behavior is strong, bucket partitioning and alignment-capacity restrictions add unnecessary complexity.
counterhypothesis_reason: Current primary research gives two independent failure modes for the aggregate-only rule: heterogeneous causal faithfulness across input/pair regions and vacuous alignment under excessive mapping capacity. These do not prove a Clay-specific failure, but they justify fail-closed evaluation gates before positive J-Space labels.

required_before_positive_jspace_promotio: freeze alignment/projection map class, rank or complexity budget, training data and optimization procedure before holdout inspection
partition intervention pairs by Hyperposition context, function, family/provenance, nuisance signature, variable-binding depth and shortcut availability
report per-bucket causal effect, rescue/reversibility, off-target damage and coverage in addition to global aggregates
require preregistered worst-bucket and minimum-coverage bounds rather than mean-only acceptance
include shuffled-label, shuffled-site, random-direction and other admitted negative controls appropriate to the exact model/runtime
where feasible include a capacity-matched null alignment or random/untrained-model control so flexible mappings cannot self-authenticate causal meaning
treat any post-hoc expansion of alignment capacity, layer search or bucket deletion after holdout inspection as a new hypothesis requiring a fresh frozen holdout
keep semantic Hyperposition carrier claims separate from raw coordinate/subspace claims until exact model-specific intervention evidence closes both

hard_negative_blueprints_only.case: high aggregate intervention score but one preregistered context/family bucket shows systematic lesion-rescue failure
restricted preregistered map fails, then a more expressive post-hoc map reaches high causal score on the inspected holdout
endpoint accuracy is high in shortcut-solvable/early-position cases but degrades on matched deep-hop or shortcut-contradicting distractor cases
